0022600160.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 7th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-5, 12th in the East) after a loss in their most recent game, while Indiana has dropped four straight and is 0-3 at home. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (fracture in the foot), and Jalen Johnson (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Hawks won the 2025-26 series 2-1, though their last meeting, a 129-124 loss in Indianapolis on January 31, 2026, went to the Pacers.
